description: A title at rest: `THE END` in the shipped sans face, amber, three tenths of the frame's height, centred on black with no keyframes anywhere. The reference is the letter shapes themselves, so it fails if the glyphs move, change size, change colour, change face, or stop being drawn at all. Both frames are compared because a text layer is drawn once for a clip and reused: if that reuse were wrong, the first frame would be right and the last one blank. Nothing here has a file — the whole picture comes out of the assets table.
